ground_truth_isolation.description: Enforces strict purge of historical analyst notes, ground truth labels, and AI predictions from reviewer feeds and LLM prompt context.

empirical_safety_verification.description: Verifies that signed binaries in System32 alone cannot establish FP authorization, expired maintenance windows are rejected, and unverified SIEM provenance blocks closure.

gpu_circuit_breaker.description: Verifies circuit breaker trips to OPEN upon consecutive failures, recovers in half-open state, and bounds concurrent GPU slots.

structured_output_and_injection.description: Verifies adversarial prompt injection payloads embedded in raw logs are completely neutralized by deterministic structural validator.

auth_and_rbac.description: Verifies password hashing, token expiration, JWT authentication, and strict denial of admin routes for analyst role.
